---
name: skill-creator
description: Create, refine, validate, and evaluate E-Collab skills without duplicating or weakening existing guidance.
---

# Skill Creator

Before creating a skill, inspect existing skills and the task domain. Define a narrow capability, explicit activation description, inputs, outputs, constraints, failure modes, and validation method.

Prefer procedural instructions over generic advice. Keep skills composable and avoid overlapping responsibilities. Test activation against direct wording, paraphrases, and supporting requests. Update a skill when evidence shows poor recall or repeated failures.

Never add a skill merely because another repository has one. Adapt only when its capability maps to E-Collab.
